You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This module specifies the Dining Philosophers problem for N philosophers arranged in a ring, using a simple asymmetric fork-acquisition strategy to avoid deadlock. Philosophers 1 through N-1 pick up their right fork and then their left fork, while philosopher 0 picks up the forks in the opposite order; the translated TLA+ model represents control flow with the variable pc and fork availability with the function sem. The specification defines the initial state, individual philosopher actions, the global next-state relation, and a temporal specification with strong fairness for every process; it also states a mutual-exclusion style safety invariant saying adjacent philosophers do not eat simultaneously, and a starvation-freedom property requiring each philosopher to eat infinitely often.
